questions.question: What makes a clip good?
questions.why: Separation prevents entertainment compensating for distortion.
questions.approaches: Weighted composite vs hard gates then ranking
questions.support_and_conflict: Composite is convenient but masks fatal failures; independent gates add review cost and ambiguity.
questions.cheapest_decisive_experiment: Blind source comparison of 12 variants incl omitted qualifications; compare errors under both policies.
questions.recommendation: Faithfulness, standalone meaning, required context, technical/rights gates; rank interest, opening/pacing/ending/value; diversity across slate.

questions.question: Reliable human gold
questions.approaches: Single rating vs double annotation + paired choices
questions.support_and_conflict: Ratings support diagnostics but scale drift; paired choices relative, expensive, and can compare two bad clips.
questions.cheapest_decisive_experiment: Two raters independently score pilot; third adjudicates hard disagreements; report kappa/alpha and preference counts.
questions.recommendation: Two-pass independent review; retain uncertainty and raw ratings; no majority of AI substitutes.

questions.question: Open discovery ground truth
questions.approaches: Model-only pools vs exhaustive source + pooled audit
questions.support_and_conflict: Pools efficient but miss common blind spots; exhaustive watching still subjective.
questions.cheapest_decisive_experiment: Two reviewers watch each pilot VOD before proposals; then blind pool and random negatives; record newly found events.
questions.recommendation: Independent coverage first, pool only to refine next frozen version, report known-positive recall if incomplete.
questions.uncertainty: True recall unknowable on incomplete labels

questions.question: Human interestingness
questions.why: Replay and audio peaks not audience-independent quality.
questions.approaches: Replay labels vs editorial choices vs engagement
questions.support_and_conflict: Replay cheap/noisy, preferences nuanced but costly; engagement confounded by exposure.
questions.cheapest_decisive_experiment: Same candidate pool, compare heuristic, text-only, multimodal ranking using blind pairs and negative cases.
questions.recommendation: Use replay for weak training and diagnostic, source-independent human preference for evaluation.

questions.question: Contextual memory
questions.why: Correct answer can be guessed without evidence.
questions.approaches: Local window vs flat global vs hierarchy; supplied vs generated query
questions.support_and_conflict: Global can retrieve distant evidence but irrelevant cost; oracle queries overstate autonomy.
questions.cheapest_decisive_experiment: E02 and E03 with hidden needs and fixed retrieval backend; include no-support and unrelated same-entity.
questions.recommendation: Evaluate missing-need detection, closure, false evidence, stop and cost independently; use flat baseline.

questions.question: Narrative relationships
questions.approaches: Implicit reasoning vs typed graph with verification
questions.support_and_conflict: Typed graph inspectable but extraction errors and cost; removal can introduce artifacts.
questions.cheapest_decisive_experiment: E05 matched anchors, near distractors, remote callbacks, oracle and detected nodes; blind grouped removal/restoration.
questions.recommendation: Test typed edges and semantic closure separately before graph commitment.
questions.uncertainty: NEST code unavailable; human necessity disagreement

questions.question: Boundary quality
questions.why: High IoU can lose one decisive word.
questions.approaches: Fixed padding or IoU vs conditional paired closure
questions.support_and_conflict: Structured labels expensive but preserve alternatives; tIoU cheap but insufficient.
questions.cheapest_decisive_experiment: E06 paired candidate variants with omitted qualification, alternate setup, and snap mutation.
questions.recommendation: Use required evidence, acceptable linked pairs, campaign constraints and independent semantic review.

questions.question: Abstention
questions.evidence: Keystone metrics v2; Rhapsody empty skip
questions.approaches: Score only successful jobs vs assigned roster with reasons
questions.support_and_conflict: Conditional metric useful diagnosis but optimistic if used alone.
questions.cheapest_decisive_experiment: Run synthetic and real negatives plus induced failures/partial coverage; compare strict and conditional rates.
questions.recommendation: Keep every assigned source, status and reason; false negative includes failed positive; zero precision null.

questions.question: AI judge
questions.approaches: Sole judge vs human-only vs calibrated triage
questions.support_and_conflict: LLM judges scalable but bias and source limitations; human workload high.
questions.cheapest_decisive_experiment: Blind two-family swapped judge evaluation vs dev human ratings; audit accepted high-risk clips.
questions.resources: Pilot pairs; API approval if needed
questions.recommendation: Deterministic checks first, AI triage after calibration, humans retain final authority.

questions.question: Fair budget comparison
questions.why: Higher quality from more compute may not be engineering gain.
questions.approaches: Equal declared limits vs actual costs/Pareto
questions.support_and_conflict: Equal spend not same access; actual latency/cost missing for subscriptions.
questions.cheapest_decisive_experiment: E01–E08 at same relevant caps, cold and warm separately, budget sweep on dev.
questions.recommendation: Match coverage, roster, caps, renderer and available modalities except intentional intervention; publish actual cost.
questions.uncertainty: Pilot caps and hardware need calibration

questions.question: Initial sample size
questions.support_and_conflict: Pilot inexpensive but cannot generalize; larger sample better yet annotation burden.
questions.cheapest_decisive_experiment: 4 VOD pilot, 12 VOD expansion, estimate creator variance and learning curves.
questions.recommendation: Pilot for instrumentation, expanded holdout for decisions, no significance claim until enough creators.
questions.uncertainty: Access, rate of positives and variance unknown

questions.question: Integration gates
questions.why: Prevent research demos being deployed as proven improvements.
questions.approaches: Aggregate score vs per-module guardrail and E08
questions.support_and_conflict: Single score hides tradeoffs; stage gates more work but isolates causality.
questions.cheapest_decisive_experiment: Run E01–E08 then leave-one-component-out; preregister margins after pilot and before locked test.
questions.recommendation: Require correctness, budget and coverage, paired practical gain and no serious distortion; Nexus approves.
questions.uncertainty: Margins and sample size not yet empirically derived
